Daddy Shannon’s

A lovely jig composed by Sharon Shannon, to her father for his 93 year birthday.

Re: Daddy Shannon’s

“Regarding chords, I’m not the best person to do it, but I think it sounds OK.”

Mmm… not too sure about some of your chord choices, ceili.
In particular your C chords are both set against C# notes in the melody and your Fbm (=Em, by the way) chord is set against an E# (=F) note in the melody.

↳ Posted by DonaldK on December 24th, 2022.

Daddy Shannon’s, X:3

Here’s how I hear this tune (which has a bit of a two-step feel in the first part), with chords, from the composer’s setting on The Reckoning: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-4PAiZ09n4Y

As noted above, there are little variations in the last two parts (bars 1&2 of the third part and bars 3&4 of the fourth part).

Oh, and forgot to mention, on the recording the tune is up a half step in Eb.

↳ Posted by DonaldK on December 25th, 2022.
